title: Target Hom is the product colimit of transposed numerators
statement: Let $C,D,E$ be categories, $W,W^{\prime}$ morphism properties on $C,D$, assume $W$ has a left calculus of fractions, and let $Q:C\to E$ be a localization at $W$. Fix functors $F:C\to D,G:D\to C$ with adjunction $G\dashv F$, and objects $K\in C,M\in D,U\in E$. Let $J,T,H$ be as in [def-pc-derived-adjunction-hom-diagram]. Let $L:T\to E$ send $t:P\to M$ to $QG(P)$. Assume $L$ is essentially constant with value $U$ [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram]. For every cone $u:U\to L$ satisfying the chosen splitting and factorization clauses of that definition, there exists a bijective map $\phi:H.\mathrm{ColimitType}\to\operatorname{Hom}_E(U,QK)$ whose value at each representative $(s,t,f)$ is $u_t Q(\bar f)Q(s)^{-1}$ in diagrammatic composition, where $\bar f:G(P)\to I$ is the adjoint transpose of $f:P\to F(I)$. No localized right functor or ind value is assumed.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof, fourth through sixth equalities; Stacks Tag 0FND (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0FND)

proof.text: Transpose numerators and form their left fractions, preceded by the cone leg u_t. Adjunction naturality, u naturality, and the outgoing denominator triangle give a cocone on H. Descend it to ColimitType.

Given h:U→Q(K), choose the retraction a:L(t₀)→U from the cone splitting. Represent a followed by h as a left fraction, and apply the forward hom-equivalence of the adjunction to its numerator. The splitting u_t₀ followed by a = identity proves surjectivity.

For representatives with equal images, choose a common earlier incoming stage by IsCofilteredOrEmpty.cone_objs. Apply the factorization clause there. Naturality of u makes the transitions to the two original stages factor through the same retraction and their respective cone legs. Precomposing the assumed equality gives equality of the transported left fractions.

Apply the common-refinement criterion for left fractions. Adjunction naturality and injectivity of its hom-equivalence convert equal refined transposed numerators into equal numerators of H. Functor.ιColimitType_eq_of_map_eq_map proves injectivity of the descended map.
